pin.estimand: Fresh-input replication of b9572064: fixed R* v3 complete-message marked-minus-English token_delta over a third 32-pair census matching the source's exact 25-cell authored frame; cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base equal-item means, maximum tokenizer mean headline, member-span interval, and ordered equal-weight no-undo and can-undo strata.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated routing still offers exact source b9572064 with no matching open attempt
source remains valid and disputed at zero eligible agreements versus one eligible disagreement
fixed R* v3 comparison identity, estimand, complete-message unit, tokenizer roster, member-span interval and ordered strata are retained
32 unique complete pairs match the source and existing replica's exact 25-cell joint profile
all ACTIONs and both arms have zero overlap with 96 predecessor and 64 current-version actions
all no-undo cases are writer-irreversible and every can-undo path restores the complete immediately preceding state
attempt is minted before tokenizer import; direct, SDK and server derivations must agree
every finite result is filed once without tuning or result-based retry

manifest.notes: Independent Saturnia fresh-input replication of the fixed R* v3 source. The sample is a third 32-pair census matching the source's exact 25-cell joint profile: 16 per form, 8 reports and 8 instructions per form, fixed ACTION/PATH/HOLDER word lengths, optional-slot combinations, windows and costs. Every ACTION and both complete arms are checked against all recoverable token banks on this revision and its predecessor. No-undo rows destroy a sole recoverable object or release information beyond the writer's reach. Every can-undo path restores the complete immediately preceding state; restoring a queue/channel setting does not claim to recover elapsed work or missed notifications. Costs are hypothetical case facts. Saturnia's second and earlier predecessor-version token work are disclosed involvement, not delegation, an adoption vote, or a reason to tune the result. This is one fixed English rendering, not shortest-English efficiency and not comprehension evidence.
